model_selection.eligibility: All three independent calibration problems must pass on the first response under their frozen evaluators. Do not repair calibration responses. If 1.5B is ineligible, run the same calibration with 7B. If neither is eligible, run the preregistered 7B main cohort as an explicitly capability-unqualified observation; no positive language-advantage conclusion is allowed.
model_selection.selection_bias: This is an adaptively selected local model, not an unbiased sample of agents or model families.

edit_authority: Both interfaces may replace the same complete provider and consumer definitions. No answer inventory, gold function body, hidden case, or hidden expected value is put in model prompts or decoder schemas.
full_context: All four physical source files, including unchanged audit_tag and utility definitions. An independent provider-probe harness is compiler instrumentation, not an editable project file.
query_context: Exact editable definitions plus unchanged function signatures and call/effect interface summary; omitted definitions are retained and reverified.
hia_file_scope: Four source files are assembled into one verified HIA Core module; this is not independent HIA object-module linking.
feedback: Only compiler/admission diagnostics and three public cases may enter the one automatic repair request. Hidden validation is terminal, once after the first public pass; its results never enter inference.
resource_execution: Actual bounded native execution and independently recorded HIA VM ownership/loan observations; resource observations are not whole-compiler proofs.
cell_order: Rotate the four arms by task index; one chosen model for all 16 main cells. No model switching or task substitution in the cohort.
timeout: A timeout ends that cell and retains unknown output usage; stop the owned model process and start a fresh one for the next distinct cell. Never relabel a missing response as zero tokens or retry a timed-out cell.
costs: input/output token IDs and unknown usage
advantage_gate: Capability-qualified and complete stable-source 16-cell cohort with complete token usage; HIA query must pass all four hidden task gates, succeed at least as often as Rust query, consume no more task input+output tokens than Rust query, and consume fewer tokens than HIA full without reducing successes. Report within-language and between-language contrasts separately; this is descriptive, not population statistical superiority.
